mapper.select:
select vfsp.id, vfsp.serve_point_name, vfsp.serve_point_addr, vfsp.duty_name, vfsp.duty_phone, vfsp.grid_code, vfsp.grid_name, vfsp.created_time, vfsp.updated_time, vfsp.lat, vfsp.lon from village_financial_service_points vfsp left join pa_addr_info_type pait on vfsp.grid_code = pait.code
and serve_point_name like concat('%', #{servePointName}, '%')
and (
pait.ancestor_codes like concat('%,', #{item}, ',%')
)
mapper.sql: select vfsp.created_time, vfsp.duty_name, vfsp.duty_phone, vfsp.grid_code, vfsp.grid_name, vfsp.id, vfsp.lat, vfsp.lon, vfsp.serve_point_addr, vfsp.serve_point_name, vfsp.updated_time
mapper.select: from village_financial_service_points vfsp left join pa_addr_info_type pait on vfsp.grid_code = pait.code where ancestor_codes like concat('%,', #{gridCode},',%')

select vfsp.serve_point_name, vfsp.serve_point_addr, vfsp.duty_name, vfsp.duty_phone, vfsp.grid_name from village_financial_service_points vfsp left join pa_addr_info_type pait on vfsp.grid_code = pait.code
and serve_point_name like concat('%', #{servePointName}, '%')
and (
pait.ancestor_codes like concat('%,', #{item}, ',%')
)
